name: CLI & TUI Interfaces
description: User-facing surfaces of the opencode agent: the yargs CLI command tree, the OpenTUI terminal app with its dialogs, themes and keybinds, the headless `run` UI, and the ACP adapter that embeds the agent in editors like Zed.

name: HTTP API Server
description: Effect HttpApi server exposing the 50-endpoint REST surface and SSE event streams (sessions, messages, files, config, providers) with auth, CORS, mDNS discovery, and PTY terminal attach, consumed by the web and desktop clients.

name: Agent Session Core
description: The agent runtime: the SessionPrompt run loop, prompt assembly and compaction, message schemas and projectors, agent definitions, the V2 session API, bus events, config loading, project/worktree management, and the package composition roots.

name: Providers, Tools & Extensions
description: Capability integrations the agent loop draws on: LLM provider adapters and transforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, Copilot, models.dev registry), built-in tools (bash, edit, webfetch, grep), permission gating, and the MCP, LSP, skill, plugin, search, auth, and IDE extension systems.

name: Data & Persistence
description: SQLite/Drizzle persistence for the agent: session and message tables, 19 schema migrations, the storage layer, cross-device sync, the data-migration runner, share links, and account state.

name: Web App Client
description: SolidJS web client (packages/app) that drives the agent over the HTTP API: components, pages, the global-sync SSE state engine in context/, i18n, and Vite/Playwright build wiring.

name: Shared UI Library
description: Shared SolidJS component kit (@opencode-ai/ui) used by the web app: 130+ components, theme tokens, Pierre styling, assets and i18n primitives, plus the Storybook workshop that showcases them.

name: Shared Core & SDK
description: Cross-package foundations and public API surface: @opencode-ai/core (Effect-zod bridge, logging, flags), opencode's internal util modules (filesystem, wildcard, file references, formatters), the Rust/WASM diff engine, the generated @opencode-ai/sdk client, and @opencode-ai/plugin types.

name: Documentation & Sites
description: Published documentation: the Astro/Starlight docs and share site (packages/web), the Mintlify API reference (packages/docs), root guides (README, CONTRIBUTING, CHANGELOG), per-package AGENTS.md instructions, specs, and the .jules performance log.

name: Infrastructure, CI & Release
description: Build, CI, and delivery plumbing: Bun/Turbo workspace config, SST cloud infrastructure, GitHub Actions workflows and CI containers, release scripts, Dockerfiles, Nix packaging, dependency patches, and the standalone /opencode GitHub Action.
